## Eigene Beispiele / Code

::: panel-tabset
## R

```r
km <- kmeans(df_scaled, centers = 3)
table(km$cluster)
```

## Python

```python
from sklearn.cluster import KMeans
km = KMeans(n_clusters=3, n_init=10).fit(X_scaled)
print(km.labels_)
```
:::
